title: A Codex review child's termal_review_identity returns input_unavailable (observer status 1, OS error 2 "file not found") before any source inspection
outcome: A Codex review child's identity check either succeeds on a valid frozen input, or fails naming the exact missing path, so the review pair is not silently left incomplete.
acceptance: An entry of the observed git metadata trees (objects/ and refs/ of the own and common git dir) that vanishes between listing and inspection no longer fails termal_review_identity: a vanished entry cannot be a link or escape, so it is skipped and the capture/check completes (verified on an unchanged input). A deterministic test removes such an entry mid-walk (cfg(test) seam) and asserts a complete, verified result.

Any other io failure of the identity observer names the path it could not read in the observer's stderr (no bare "os error 2"); a failure inside the shared Git runner's own setup names the review root. A test forces one such failure and asserts the path appears.
The full gate passes on the exact landed tree, with a clean independent review pair.

completion.summary: Completed: all 3 acceptance criteria passed in fresh independent evaluation 34b543ec; full gate 2089cab5 passed on the exact landed tree. Commit 852c0a98 is on origin/master and installed as target/release/termal.exe.
